body.purpose: All running text, table cells, descriptions, form values.

label.purpose: Form labels, KPI metrics, badge text, version numbers, timestamps.

title.purpose: Card titles, section headings within pages.

headline.purpose: Page titles. One per page, always at the top of the content area.

shadows.name: panel-float
shadows.purpose: Dropdown menus and floating panels. The only shadow used on interactive overlays.

shadows.name: dialog-elevated
shadows.purpose: Dialog popups and confirm modals. Stronger elevation to signal interruption.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover, focus, and state transitions. 150-250ms duration.

motion.name: overlay-enter
motion.purpose: Dropdown and dialog entry. Ease-out-expo for overlay appearance.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button. Olive Guardian background, sharp corners, compact height.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.62 0.18 145); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.62 0.18 145 / 80%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.62 0.18 145 / 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. White background with border stroke.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: oklch(0.99 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); border-radius: 0; padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.96 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.62 0.18 145 / 50%); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Danger action. Tinted red background, never solid red.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: oklch(0.6 0.22 27 / 10%); color: oklch(0.6 0.22 27); border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); outline: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.6 0.22 27 / 20%); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.6 0.22 27 / 20%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form input. Sharp corners, transparent background, compact 32px height.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: oklch(0.18 0 0); outline: none; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.5 0 0); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.62 0.18 145); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.62 0.18 145 / 50%); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status indicator. Pill-shaped with tinted background. Always includes text label.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-badge-success { background: oklch(0.65 0.19 155 / 15%); color: oklch(0.55 0.15 155); border-color: oklch(0.65 0.19 155 / 30%); } .ds-badge-warning { background: oklch(0.75 0.15 85 / 15%); color: oklch(0.65 0.13 85); border-color: oklch(0.75 0.15 85 / 30%); } .ds-badge-destructive { background: oklch(0.6 0.22 27 / 15%); color: oklch(0.5 0.2 27); border-color: oklch(0.6 0.22 27 / 30%); } .ds-badge-info { background: oklch(0.65 0.12 230 / 15%); color: oklch(0.55 0.1 230); border-color: oklch(0.65 0.12 230 / 30%); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Flat content container. No shadow, subtle ring outline. Sharp corners.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Fixed RTL sidebar with active state highlighting. 256px wide.
components.css: .ds-sidebar { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh; width: 256px; flex-shrink: 0; background: oklch(0.99 0 0); color: oklch(0.18 0 0); display: flex; flex-direction: column; border-inline-end: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); } .ds-sidebar-header { padding: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid oklch(0.9 0 0); font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; } .ds-sidebar-list { list-style: none; padding: 8px; margin: 0; flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; } .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Tajawal', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.18 0 0); text-decoration: none; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-sidebar-item:hover { background: oklch(0.95 0.01 145); } .ds-sidebar-active { background: oklch(0.62 0.18 145); color: oklch(0.99 0 0); } .ds-sidebar-active:hover { background: oklch(0.62 0.18 145); }

narrative.overview:
This design system is a bound book of records: unadorned but dignified. Pages turn predictably. You trust it because nothing is flashy, because the format never changes unexpectedly, because every entry is given the same careful weight. The interface disappears into the work.

The register is built on restraint. Palestinian identity is present in color (olive green, ember red, ink black) and language (Arabic throughout, RTL as structural foundation), never in decoration. Every surface is flat or near-flat. Every corner is sharp (0px radius on cards, buttons, inputs). Typography uses one family at a compact scale. The palette is narrow: one green accent, one red for danger, and achromatic neutrals. This is a Restrained color strategy by doctrine, not default.
keyCharacteristics: Sharp corners everywhere (0px radius on all interactive and structural elements)
Single-family Arabic typography (Tajawal) at a compact, data-dense scale
Restrained palette: olive green accent on ≤10% of any given surface
Flat elevation: tonal layering via background lightness, no drop shadows on content cards
RTL-first layout using logical properties (start/end, ps/pe)

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Olive Guardian is the only saturated color permitted on interactive surfaces. It appears on primary buttons, active states, and focus rings. Ember Authority appears only for destructive/error semantics. No other saturated colors exist in the interface palette.

rules.name: The Zero Chromatic Neutrals Rule
rules.body: All neutrals (Parchment Surface, Mist Muted, Stone Border, Ink Foundation) are achromatic (chroma 0). The only tinted neutral is Sage Whisper (chroma 0.01, hue 145), which is restricted to accent backgrounds and hover states.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Tajawal is the only font. No display fonts, no mono fonts for data, no icon fonts. Icons are inline SVG via Lucide. Weight and size create hierarchy; the family stays constant.

rules.name: The Flat Content Rule
rules.body: Content areas are flat. Shadows are reserved for elements that float above the page surface: dialogs, dropdowns, and popovers. If a shadow appears on a card that sits in the normal document flow, it is wrong.

dos: Do keep Olive Guardian under 10% of any screen surface area. It is an accent, not a theme color.
Do use sharp corners (0px radius) on all cards, buttons, inputs, dropdowns, and checkboxes.
Do provide text labels on every badge and status indicator. Color alone must not convey meaning.
Do use dir="ltr" on any input field that accepts Latin characters (codes, amounts, usernames).
Do use tonal background shifts (Mist Muted, Sage Whisper) for depth instead of shadows on content elements.
Do maintain the one-family rule. Tajawal at all weights and sizes.
Do keep the component vocabulary consistent across every screen.
donts: Don't use a SaaS dashboard with hero metrics and gradient accents. This is a register, not a marketing surface.
Don't use donation platform patterns with emotional imagery or fundraising theatrics.
Don't use consumer app patterns: playful illustrations, onboarding gamification, or decorative motion.
Don't use western-style admin panel patterns that ignore RTL and Arabic typography.
Don't apply border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Use weight or size for emphasis.
Don't use glassmorphism or blur effects on any surface.
Don't nest cards inside cards. Use tonal surfaces or bordered divs for inner grouping.
Don't add decorative motion that does not convey state.
